{{Quote|Good news, however, came in for the Republic from Balamak in the Mid Rim, where Anakin Skywalker again proved his stratospheric talent by firing missiles that destroyed a Droid Control Ship&mdash;a ship that happened to be carrying prototype communications jammer that could have taken out an entire HoloNet node.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC" />}}
The '''CIS Jammer Prototype''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] that served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was outfitted with a modified [[Transmitter/Legends|transmission array]] that could broadcast [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] signals. In [[22 BBY/Legends|21.25 BBY]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was part of a [[Unidentified Confederacy of Independent Systems flotilla|Confederate flotilla]] that arrived over the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Balamak/Legends|Balamak]] and disrupted the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector's]] communications. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] subsequently carried out a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Battle of Balamak/Legends|attack]] on the [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]], and Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the CIS Jammer Prototype with a volley of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].

==Description==
{{Quote|One Separatist vessel was a Trade Federation Droid Control Ship with a modified transmission array to broadcast jamming signals capable of disrupting a key HoloNet node.|HoloNet News Core Edition report|<ref name="RHNN" />}}
The CIS Jammer Prototype<ref name="CSWE Jammer">{{CSWECite|I|128|CIS Jammer Prototype}}</ref> was a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]<ref name="RHNN" /> manufactured by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]], measuring 3,170 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter.<ref name="DB" /> It was capable of [[Atmosphere/Legends|stratospheric]] flight and was equipped with a prototype<ref name="NEC" /> modified [[Transmitter/Legends|transmission array]]. The latter could broadcast [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] signals capable of disrupting a strategic [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] node.<ref name="RHNN" />

==History==
{{Quote|Transmission networks resumed functioning today in the Taldot sector when Republic forces destroyed an experimental jamming platform employed by the Separatists.|HoloNet News Core Edition report|<ref name="RHNN" />}}
[[File:BalamakCW-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The CIS Jammer Prototype was destroyed over Balamak (depicted on map).]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|21.25 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified Confederacy of Independent Systems flotilla|flotilla]] of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] arrived over the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Balamak/Legends|Balamak]]. The CIS Prototype Jammer of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets]] was a part of the formation, serving as an experimental jamming platform. As a result, the functioning of transmission networks in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] was disrupted for four [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].<ref name="RHNN" />

In response, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactician [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] devised an [[Battle of Balamak/Legends|attack]] on the Confederacy [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. A [[Unidentified Galactic Republic task force (Balamak)|Republic task force]], led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Nanda-Ree Janoo]], carried out a starfighter attack on the enemy forces on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 14:2:12. During the ensuing confrontation<ref name="RHNN" /> in Balamak's stratosphere,<ref name="NEC" /> Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] delivered a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] volley that destroyed the CIS Jammer Prototype. Communications in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] were subsequently restored, and the [[HoloNet News Core Edition]] later reported on the result of the battle,<ref name="RHNN" /> although the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] [[Media/Legends|news]] and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program also labeled the Jammer Prototype's performance at Balamak a successful test of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] capabilities.<ref name="Shadowfeed">{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}}</ref> The destruction of the CIS Jammer Prototype was eventually recorded in a [[36 ABY]] [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|document]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CIS Jammer Prototype was first mentioned in "[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:2:12]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[HoloNet News (Insider)|in-universe news report]] that was included in the [[Star Wars Insider 65|sixty-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="RHNN" /> on [[January 21]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20021219.html|text=''Insider'' #65 & ''Bantha Tracks'' #2}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later confirmed the capitalization of the starship's name.<ref name="CSWE Jammer" />
